{{Quote|New Republic transport, prepare to be boarded! Your hyperdrive will not operate while under the influence of our gravity-well projectors. If you cooperate, this will be over quickly and painlessly.|A Lumini pirate aboard their Interdictor cruiser, to a New Republic corvette|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
After successfully [[Mission to negotiate supplies from Ka'Pa the Hutt|negotiating]] with [[Ka'Pa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] for supplies, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] sent [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] on protection detail to prevent [[pirate]]s from '''seizing''' a Jedi [[Kaerobani's holocron|Holocron]]. Jade failed when the [[Lumini pirates/Legends|Lumini pirates]] stole the [[Jedi holocron/Legends|Jedi holocron]] and took it aboard their [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]. Determined, Jade snuck onto the ship via an empty cargo crate and was brought aboard the pirates' [[Orbiting Ship Yards]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rathalay]].<ref name="MOTS" />

Jade followed the holocron to [[Kaerobani's base]] where she fought many pirates, including [[Noghri/Legends|noghri]], before finding the stolen [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] in [[Kaerobani]]'s art collection. With her prize, the Jedi stole a [[R-41 Starchaser]] and flew off for New Republic space.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The dread pirate Kaerobani (and that's me being clever with the word Caribbean) steals a Sith holocron and Mara has to chase him to his hideout.|Ryan Kaufman|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}</ref>}}
The seizure of the Jedi holocron missions appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'', making up the ninth, tenth, and eleventh levels of the game.<ref name="MOTS" /> Level designer [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] misidentified the focal holocron as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] holocron in his retrospective blog post.<ref name="Blog" />
